hero.label: StrukturKlar
hero.claim: Understand complexity. Recognise structures. Develop possibilities.
hero.subtitle: Economic analysis. Systemic thinking. Sound decision-making foundations.
text: Companies and organisations today face a particular challenge: limited resources, rising demands, increasing complexity and a dynamic competitive environment.
What matters, therefore, is not only managing existing tasks. What matters is understanding interrelationships, using resources wisely and setting the right priorities.
StrukturKlar makes complex economic and organisational situations understandable and creates a sound basis for better decisions and sustainable development.
hero.focus: I analyse structures, processes, resources and risks. From this, I develop comprehensible courses of action and conceptual solution approaches.
hero.closing: From analysis to perspective. From perspective to decision.

when.label: When StrukturKlar makes sense
when.heading: When individual problems are part of a bigger picture.
text: Perhaps you are facing an important business decision. Perhaps processes no longer work the way they should. Perhaps costs have risen, resources are scarce or responsibilities are unclear.
Often the real challenge does not lie in a single problem, but in the interrelationships between different areas.
StrukturKlar helps you make these interrelationships visible and examine them systematically.
situations: You want to start a business or develop an existing business activity further.
You have to manage limited financial and human resources economically.
You want to compare several locations, offers or investment options.
You know that processes can be improved, but not yet exactly where the causes lie.
You want to identify risks before they turn into bigger problems.
You need a structured basis for an important decision.
You want to use existing resources more purposefully and identify new development opportunities.
when.goal: The goal: not just looking at individual symptoms, but understanding the entire starting situation.

method.label: How I work
method.heading: From the facts to a basis for decision-making.
method.intro: Every question is different. The analytical approach, however, follows a clear structure.

steps.title: Understand the IST (as-is)
steps.question: What actually exists? What information, figures and framework conditions are available?

steps.title: Recognise interrelationships
steps.question: How are processes, tasks, people, resources and information connected?

steps.title: Define the goal
steps.question: What should be achieved, improved or changed?

steps.title: Identify the GAP
steps.question: What differences exist between the current and the desired situation?

steps.title: Examine risks
steps.question: Which factors can influence or hinder achieving the goal?

steps.title: Develop options
steps.question: What different courses of action are there?

steps.title: Consider the impact
steps.question: What economic, organisational and practical effects may arise?

steps.title: Create a basis for decision-making
steps.question: The results are structured comprehensibly and prepared in a suitable form.

method.closing: Good decisions do not come from individual figures. They come from understanding how those figures are connected.

decision.label: Preparing decisions
decision.heading: A good decision starts with the right questions.
text: Not every business question starts with a finished business plan. Often it starts with a specific situation, several open questions and different possibilities.
StrukturKlar helps you to organise the question, analyse the relevant factors and make possible courses of action comparable.

examples.title: Example: You are planning to start a business.
questions: What financial prerequisites are in place?
What investments need to be considered?
Which location or premises option fits the economic framework?
What information is still missing for a well-founded decision?

examples.title: Example: You want to improve existing processes.
questions: Where do delays or unnecessary work steps occur?
Where are responsibilities or interfaces unclear?
What structural changes might make sense?

examples.title: Example: You have to choose between several options.
questions: Which criteria are relevant for the comparison?
Which option best fits the available resources and goals?

decision.note: The result is not a guarantee of success, but a comprehensible analytical basis that supports your own decision-making.

support.label: Analytical project support
support.heading: Complex questions sometimes need more than a single analysis step.
text: Some challenges cannot be captured in one conversation or a single evaluation.
StrukturKlar can support analytical and conceptual projects over several steps – from the initial structuring of a question to the development and assessment of possible courses of action.
notes: The specific scope, the information required, the results and the individual work steps are agreed together in advance.
The focus is on analysis, structuring and conceptual support – not on taking over the company's operational responsibility.

about.label: About me
about.heading: From figures to structures. From structures to decisions.
text: I am Anastasiia Gurina – a finance and controlling expert with an academic background in international economics and finance and many years of professional experience in finance, accounting, controlling and organisational management processes.
My professional career began in Ukraine in 1996. Germany has been my home since 2003, and I have continuously developed my professional qualifications and experience here.

My professional positions include work in finance and accounting, responsibility for general ledger and fixed asset accounting processes, support for various corporate structures, and tasks in controlling and municipal administration.
about.tasksHeading: In my work to date, I have, among other things:
tasks: been responsible for and coordinated financial processes and closing work;
managed extensive client portfolios with different requirements;
prepared monthly closings, evaluations and management reports;
worked with controlling, management, administration and external specialist bodies;
coordinated staff professionally and structured work processes;
developed concepts and decision-making foundations for economic and organisational questions.
about.keyPhrase: What has shaped me most is the combination of financial analysis and organisational thinking: figures never stand in isolation. They reflect processes, decisions, resources and how they interact.

background.title: International economics and finance
background.text: Specialist Diploma in Economics and Finance (Diplom-Spezialistin), Kyiv, 2006. Academic degree with honours; credential evaluation by the Central Office for Foreign Education (ZAB). In Germany, the degree is classified at bachelor's level.

background.title: Tax clerk (Steuerfachangestellte)
background.text: Professional qualification in the German tax field, 2015.

background.title: Professional experience
background.text: Many years of work in finance, accounting, controlling and administration, including tasks in group structures and municipal organisations.

growth: Economic interrelationships change. Analytical methods and digital possibilities are also constantly evolving.
That is why I continuously expand my knowledge, particularly in data management, data-based process analysis, reporting and digital evaluation methods.
Further topics such as SQL, data quality and business intelligence applications are part of my ongoing professional development.
about.claim: My aim: to combine economic experience with analytical thinking and new methodological possibilities.

scope.label: Legal
scope.heading: Scope of services
scope.subheading: What StrukturKlar does – and what it does not.
text: StrukturKlar offers independent economic, organisational and conceptual analysis services.

The focus is on the systematic examination of economic and organisational interrelationships, the structuring of complex questions, the development of possible courses of action and the preparation of comprehensible decision-making foundations.
scope.focusIntro: Depending on the individual agreement, these may include in particular:
focus: analysis of cost, resource and process structures;
development of conceptual solution and management approaches;
preparation of analytical evaluations and decision-making foundations.
notOffered: tax advice or other professional assistance in tax matters, insofar as this is subject to the German Tax Advisory Act (Steuerberatungsgesetz);
legal advice or legal review of individual cases, insofar as this is subject to the German Legal Services Act (Rechtsdienstleistungsgesetz);
preparation of tax returns or annual financial statements for third parties;
ongoing financial, payroll or fixed asset accounting as a stand-alone service;
auditing or statutory audits of financial statements;
real estate brokerage or agency activities;
representation before authorities, courts, landlords or other third parties in legal or tax matters;
assumption of operational management or of responsibility for business decisions.
closing: The analysis is based on the information provided by the client and the agreed scope of services.

The results are analytical assessments and conceptual courses of action. They do not replace specialised services of licensed professions. The business decision and its implementation remain with the client.
The specific scope of services is agreed in writing before a project begins.
